@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) ((state != WR_SETUP && state != WR_ENABLE)) |=> (enable_cnt == '0)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == WR_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (apb_addr_reg == AWADDR)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == RD_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (apb_addr_reg == ARADDR)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == WR_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (write_data_reg == WDATA)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == WR_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (write_strb_reg == WSTRB)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == WR_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (write_op_pending == 1'b1)
@(posedge ACLK) disable iff(!ARESETn) (next_state == RD_SETUP && state == IDLE) |=> (read_op_pending == 1'b1)
